# crates/websign-core/tests/fixtures/gen

- `certs-basic.sh` — key types, extensions, serials and dates
- `certs-fields.sh` — distinguished-name string types
- `certs-icp.sh` — ICP-Brasil certificates
- `certs-qualified.sh` — eIDAS qcStatements certificates
- `keys.sh` — test key generation
- `lib.sh` — shared generator functions (leaf, variant, patching)
- `oracles.sh` — OpenSSL oracles that fill the manifests
- `vectors.sh` — digest, DigestInfo and signature vectors
